title: DBPSK Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate DBPSK-modulated data, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type Inherit via; {Phase rotation (rad)} sets the additional phase shift, {Decision type} sets the decision method for demodulation Hard, {Noise variance source} sets the source of noise and {Noise variance} sets the variance of noise. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: DBPSK-modulated baseband signal scalar | column vector

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: Noise variance positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Decision method for demodulation Hard decision (default) | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: Source of noise variance Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit via internal (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean
